_description: Analytics fields to ADD to the existing generated_apps collection in pb_schema.json. These fields enable the admin dashboard, cost tracking, and ecosystem data strategy.

add_fields.name: blueprint_confidence
add_fields.description: Gemini Flash confidence score (0.0-1.0). 0.0 = fallback blueprint used. NULL = pre-optimization generation (no confidence data).

add_fields.name: compile_attempts
add_fields.description: How many Claude API calls were made before success (or max retries). 1 = first-attempt success. 3 = all retries exhausted.

add_fields.name: compile_duration_ms
add_fields.description: Total wall-clock time for the compile phase in milliseconds. Measured from first Claude call to final status update (ready or needs_review).

add_fields.name: total_cost_estimate
add_fields.description: Estimated total API cost in USD for this generation. Sum of Gemini Flash cost + all Claude attempts. Calculated from token usage when available, otherwise estimated from blueprint complexity.

add_fields.name: prompt_category
add_fields.description: Category from Wizard Step 1 (purpose). Maps to: inventory_stock→inventory, staff_crew→staff, customers_sales→customers, scheduling_jobs→scheduling, something_else→other.

add_fields.name: user_edited_blueprint
add_fields.description: TRUE if the user unchecked any sections on the BlueprintReview screen. Indicates human-in-the-loop intervention beyond the AI blueprint.

add_fields.name: edited_sections
add_fields.description: Array of section IDs the user unchecked on BlueprintReview. E.g., ["data_field_customer_email", "view_reports"]. NULL = no sections were unchecked.

add_fields.name: gemini_input_tokens
add_fields.description: Actual input token count for the Gemini Flash call (from API response usage metadata).

add_fields.name: gemini_output_tokens
add_fields.description: Actual output token count for the Gemini Flash call.

add_fields.name: claude_input_tokens
add_fields.description: Total input tokens across ALL Claude attempts (sum of usage.input_tokens for each attempt).

add_fields.name: claude_output_tokens
add_fields.description: Total output tokens across ALL Claude attempts (sum of usage.output_tokens for each attempt).

add_fields.name: prompt_version
add_fields.description: Version string of the prompt templates used (e.g., 'blueprint:2.0.0, compile:2.0.0'). For A/B testing and regression tracking.

add_fields.name: compile_model
add_fields.description: Which model performed the successful compilation. For A/B testing Claude vs GPT-4o.

add_fields.name: fallback_used
add_fields.description: TRUE if the fallback blueprint was used (Gemini returned unparseable JSON). Indicates generation quality issue.

add_fields.name: blueprint_cache_hit
add_fields.description: TRUE if this blueprint was served from cache rather than a fresh Gemini call.

add_fields.name: view_count
add_fields.description: Number of times the user viewed/loaded this app in the Preview Sandbox. Engagement metric.

add_fields.name: download_count
add_fields.description: Number of times the user downloaded the ZIP. Pro engagement metric.

_implementation_notes.blueprint_confidence: Capture from Gemini response. Set to 0.0 if fallback blueprint was used. Set to null for apps generated before this field was added.
_implementation_notes.compile_attempts: Set after compile-app.mjs finishes (success or max retries). Increment with each Claude API call.
_implementation_notes.compile_duration_ms: Record Date.now() before first Claude call, subtract from Date.now() after final status update.
_implementation_notes.total_cost_estimate: Calculate: (gemini_input * 0.0000001 + gemini_output * 0.0000004 + claude_input * 0.000003 + claude_output * 0.000015). If token counts unavailable, estimate from blueprint complexity.
_implementation_notes.prompt_category: Derive from wizardData.purpose using PURPOSE_CATEGORY_MAP. Store as lowercase string matching the select values.
_implementation_notes.user_edited_blueprint: Check confirmedSections array from compile-app request against the full blueprint sections list.
_implementation_notes.prompt_version: Set from PROMPT_VERSION constant. Update when prompts change.
_implementation_notes.compile_model: Record which model succeeded. If multiple attempts used different models, record the successful one.
_implementation_notes.fallback_used: Set to true only when generateFallbackBlueprint() was invoked.
_implementation_notes.blueprint_cache_hit: Set to true when blueprint was served from blueprint_cache collection.
